events.title: A Cryptid to a Card
events.summary: This is a peek behind the curtain, finding out what goes into creating a new card. We'll go from initial concept to implementation and fixing it after playtesting. events.title: Meet Portentum: a cryptid deck-building auto battler
events.summary: Portentum is a deck-building auto battler starring cryptids. You collect a deck of monsters, roll and manipulate dice to fire off their abilities, and watch your team auto-battle round after round. A yeti damaging the entire board with a blizzard. Meet the cryptidsCryptids are what broke us out on Fortnite. Hunt Bigfoot was the game that took Snowfall from zero to something, and Hunt TRex followed right behind it.
